tagline: Underwater取景器相机，1997 年发布
description: Underwater于1997年推出的取景器相机。配备F3.5 / 34mm (3 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度Mechanical, behind the lens。使用24x36mm。感光度ISO 100 or ISO 400, DX code auto recognized.。Fixfocus, 1 meter till infinity。

specs.曝光测光: Underexposure warning by red LED; 3 diaphragm settings
specs.感光度: ISO 100 or ISO 400, DX code auto recognized.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in flash. Guide number (above water) 10 with ISO 100; Recharge time 6 seconds
specs.英文简介: The Mauritius is an underwater camera produced by (or for) the German company Cullmann in about 1997.
